prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application direction comp, 1440x1000 landscape
Primary request: Design the executive dashboard first viewport for a Thai university planning, budget, project, disbursement, and quality KPI management system. The visual world is an indexed evidence registry: every budget and project is one traceable record moving from budget request to approved project to quarterly result to KPI evidence.
Scene/backdrop: bright daytime administrative workspace translated into a crisp digital registry, not a photographed desk.
Composition/framing: narrow orange indexed navigation rail on the left; a thin horizontal lifecycle register across the top showing คำของบ → โครงการ → ดำเนินงาน → เบิกจ่าย → KPI; a dense central exception register with realistic Thai sample rows; a contextual record dossier on the right that shows owner, status, budget, progress, and evidence count. Make the first viewport unmistakably about traceability and decisions, not a generic analytics dashboard.
Style/medium: polished production-grade SaaS UI mockup, clean flat surfaces, archival index tabs, ledger rules, precise alignment, strong typography, restrained tactile pressed controls.
Color palette: burnt orange #C2410C, vivid orange #EA580C, warm white #FFF9F5, pure white, ink charcoal #292524, restrained green #166534 and red only for states.
Materials/textures: digital index tabs and ledger rules, nearly textureless; no fake paper texture.
Text (verbatim where legible): ระบบบริหารแผน, ภาพรวมผู้บริหาร, ข้อมูลตัวอย่าง, คำของบ, โครงการ, ดำเนินงาน, เบิกจ่าย, KPI, รายการที่ต้องตัดสินใจ, ปีงบประมาณ 2570, ไตรมาส 1.
Constraints: Thai-first UI; role-aware executive view; tabular numerals; white/orange brand; accessible contrast; clear labels plus color for status; realistic dense data; no logo invention; no charts without labels; no browser chrome.
Avoid: generic four floating KPI cards, glassmorphism, gradients, huge rounded cards, purple or blue brand accents, decorative illustrations, over-rounded pills, dark mode, stock icons, fake institutional seal.
